notes: v673 - the auto-pilot's minimum-score gate was judging shares by whether you had VISITED certain screens, not by what the data says. The score it checks was only ever written onto a share as a side effect of other views running (Top 20, Today's picks, the table filters) - so a session that went straight to ▶ Run scored every share 0 and failed the lot: the '947 reached it and none got through' diary, on a day full of 7+ shares. The gate now computes the score itself, the same way the table's ⭐ column does, so the bot gives the same answer no matter which screens you opened first - on customer, on beta, on a fresh device. The Top-20 source and the final ranking had the same dependence and are fixed the same way. And because a score of 0 can mean 'genuinely quiet' OR 'history not loaded yet' - opposite problems - the diary now says which: if most tested shares had no history in this session, it tells you to let the download finish and Run again. Also fixed a crash-in-waiting where a corrupted source setting would have thrown an error instead of standing aside. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
